events.title: Brisbane Winter Sessions: DJ Vadim
events.description: International DJ and producer Vadim brings his unique blend of hip-hop, soul, and electronica to an intimate setting in West End. This performance is part of the broader Brisbane Winter Sessions festival program.

events.title: Back to the Tivoli
events.description: A variety show featuring classic musical performances and stage acts in a nostalgic, theatrical format. It is a long-standing production series that focuses on traditional entertainment styles.

events.title: Brisbane Winter Sessions: Various Artists
events.description: A curated multi-venue live music takeover across Fortitude Valley featuring local and independent touring acts. Expect a variety of genres ranging from indie rock to experimental soundscapes.

events.title: EKKA After Dark
events.description: An evening concert experience taking place during the EKKA period, featuring live music acts at The Tivoli. The event focuses on high-energy performances suited for a night out in the city.

events.title: Brisbane Winter Sessions: Various Artists
events.description: Mid-week live music programming featuring diverse local talent across multiple stages in the Fortitude Valley cultural precinct. A great opportunity to discover new sounds in a local setting.

events.title: Brisbane Winter Sessions: Various Artists
events.description: Continued series of live music performances in Fortitude Valley, showcasing the breadth of Brisbane's music scene. Shows range from acoustic soloists to larger bands.

events.title: Brisbane Winter Sessions: Various Artists
events.description: The Brisbane Winter Sessions program continues with live acts performing across key venues in Fortitude Valley. Designed to highlight the local creative ecosystem.

events.title: Rockaria The ELO Experience
events.description: A high-production tribute concert dedicated to the music of Electric Light Orchestra, featuring a full band playing the iconic discography. Expect faithful renditions and theatrical light show elements.

events.title: Brisbane Winter Sessions: Various Artists
events.description: A busy Friday night session as part of the Brisbane Winter Sessions festival, with multiple acts performing throughout the night in local venues.

events.title: Late Night Orchestra
events.description: An evening of symphonic or large-ensemble music performed in the unique atmosphere of The Tivoli. This show is designed for a late-night setting, blending classical instrumentation with modern flair.

events.title: Brisbane Winter Sessions: The Masters Apprentices
events.description: Legendary Australian rock band The Masters Apprentices perform a live set as a headline feature of the Brisbane Winter Sessions. A chance to see iconic figures in the Australian rock history perform in a premier live music venue.

events.title: Vika & Linda: Where Do You Come From?
events.description: Acclaimed vocal duo Vika & Linda present an intimate performance exploring their heritage and musical journey through song and stories. This show is known for its strong storytelling and emotional depth.
